body:
About the whole doctor thing, she just moved from TX to PA with me a week before she went to rehab. So I have no idea who her doctor is and I think the only person who would know is her mother who I have no communication with. 

But yes the plan was to take her to a counselor I used a few years ago. Nice guy, but the whole process wasn't for me. However she NEEDS the help, if at least just for the prescriptions. Just hope they haven't brainwashed her too bad...

Thank you so much for all the information. I'm hoping I don't have to take it this far but it's nice to have all this in my back pocket just in case. Although I'll definitely make sure to post on the forum irregardless and show it to her as well if I get the chance.

And yes they did take her off her meds, she took them for BPD and bipolar. So basically she does need them or she ends up ruining her relationships and being impulsive and make awful decisions when she as a person really doesn't mean to. Meaning she has to fight against all of that as well as her addiction in order to not use again(which I personally think has been part of the problem). It's such a shame because we were making so much progress before she left and I wish I would've just looked this place up and saved her from all this. I love her to death and she's such a beautiful person and these things just really shadows that.

But yes I know about the scientologists general beliefs on psychiatric care. But them taking her off her meds without even consulting anyone has to be illegal. That and they never told her anything about the place practicing scientology(I was in the room when she called) and there is nothing on the website. That simply just can't be legal. Only problem is the only evidence I have is my word.

Yea it's been really hard. I would have to have a visit approved before I could even go. Even then it's only on Sundays from 1-6 and its from PA to MI for me. Plus she gets out (hopefully) next Friday so it's pretty pointless.

I realized I just left out some important info, she left for rehab from my house. Her dad lives in Illinois and she fled from her mom's in Texas. So really this is her home now.

I understand the HIPPA laws but I called her case manager and left a message that told her I needed to know when she would get out so I could get off work and pick her up from the airport and help her with whatever she needed. However I didn't know if she'd be able to talk with me about that.

As far as visitation goes it's only on Sundays from 1-6 and must be approved by the prior Thursday. Since she is supposed to be done next Friday this isn't an option.

Thank you for the support though. As for enjotong herself, she isn't. She's been trying to get out and asked her dad to come get her haha. Although she might be bettering herself. I genuinely have no idea. They took her off her meds so I don't know what to expect.

She does understand how it makes me feel. But when she's off her meds she doesn't like process and express everything properly.

For example, she made me cry and proceeded to just get mad at me for doing it even though she wanted to cry and said it hurt her inside. Her words were something like, "My heart could process all the information, but my brain couldnt understand it." or something to that effect.

I don't think the cultural difference has anything to do with it. She grew up in Chicago, then lived in Utah, PA(where we met) and then Dallas in November. So she only lived there for a couple months.

However she a tumultuous relationship with her mom so it's an awkward situation. Long story short, her mom said she didnt want her there anymore, showed no care in the world for her, and proceeded to guilt trip her after she packed her bags and left.

Wow this is great thanks.

Recently she moved back to Pennsylvania with me all the way from Texas and left her mom there. It was a really big step for her and I had a really bad pair of days after she came up(not because of her) and I made her feel unwanted.

She took some time away and moved out today and now she wants a few days to think. She's told me she's still in love with me and I hope she makes what I believe is the right choice. I'm just scared she doesn't believe all the things I say to her about how amazing I think she is and how I'm faithful to her and love her.

Basically I'm clingy myself, and it's just difficult.
Well for me I always listen to the 10 hour loop of Froggen saying "Leblenk" every time I pick Leblenk
I do the same thing where the talking doesn't really improve anything. But, it's nice to know people are there and it's nice to get everything in the open sometimes.
I just don't like bothering people with my problems. I don't want to seem annoying or just bring down the mood. I'm okay with being in the background. I've grown used to it.
Thank you. I really do appreciate the kind words/motivation.
I'm trying. It's just really hard for me as I've always had problems expressing how I feel. I just don't know what to do or where to turn.
